verdict.rationale: Twilio documents a public API that can be called directly over HTTPS or through official SDKs in several languages. The surface spans more than 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products, with concrete REST APIs for phone numbers, port-in, regulatory bundles, messaging and voice recording configuration. Community developers independently describe the API as very easy to use and programmable, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md) plus an MCP index of the public API specs support AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an AI agent actually driving account actions end-to-end through the API (the MCP server indexes specs only and does not execute authenticated calls).
